notes.title: Nekogumi Demo v1.02 Patch~
notes.notes: [p]Hello human, [/p][p]Just a quick note to say thank you for wishlisting the game and checking out the demo. It’s been a week since our demo launch, and we’ve made some updates to camera and controls based on early feedback, hopefully things feel a bit…smoother now.[/p][p]As a solo developer, every bit of feedback—yes, even just one bug report—means a lot. I read everything, and I try hard to make this game the best it can be. [/p][p]If you haven’t played the demo yet, now’s a great time. And if you have, thank you for being part of this journey. Your support means the world. And if you enjoyed it, consider leaving a review - it helps more than you know.[/p][p]More updates coming soon![/p][p]Ki-nodes Studio[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtube.com/shorts/AyrkDJiaEOU?feature=share"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Closing Playtest - Thanks if you're joined~
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45566566/dd594b23e08c933e47a1a030879609764dd112d7.png"][/img][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/shorts/wWpJZWdXLSU"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]Just dropping in with a quick update I’m officially closing the Steam Playtest for Nekogumi. It’s been a quiet journey, and while the feedback was limited, I want to thank those of you who gave it a try. Even if you didn’t leave feedback, I appreciate the time you spent checking it out. This phase was meant to help shape the game, and while it didn’t bring much in terms of insight, it did help me realize what I need to do next. I’ll be moving forward with a demo with some polishing so hopefully more people would get to see/try it. This was my first time using the playtest system, and I’ll admit the setup and timing weren’t ideal. But I guess that’s part of the challenge of being a developer—especially a solo one. Better get used to screaming at a wall and grow thicker skin. Anyway, thanks again to those who showed up. Moving on…[/p][p]Ki-nodes Studio[/p][p][/p]
